7655550112.label: Dean Wallace
7655550112.transcript: This is Dean Wallace's office. Our records confirm that Dr. Victor Lin spoke with Dean Wallace by telephone on November 27, 2008, beginning at 10:15 PM. The call concluded at approximately 10:40 PM.

7655550146.label: St. Agnes Children’s Hospital Billing
7655550146.transcript: Mrs. Whitmore, this is the Patient Accounts office at Saint Agnes Children's Hospital. I'm calling about Owen's upcoming procedure. We must receive the remaining balance of eighty four thousand, five hundred sixty dollars and thirty cents before November twenty eighth, two thousand eight, in order for us to proceed with Owen's procedure. Your October statement covers an earlier billing period. The current amount is listed on your November twentieth statement. Please contact our billing office as soon as possible to confirm payment arrangements. Thank you.

7655550179.label: Dr. Victor Lin
7655550179.transcript: Victor Lin speaking. Nathaniel and I worked together for years. When we received the Langford Research Award in two thousand four, I thought the work was something we could stand behind. After two thousand six, he could not reproduce those early results. He leaned harder on the graduate students. Recently, we argued. A serious argument. I told him a result does not become true because you need it to be true. I was angry. Disappointed, too. Compare the old papers with the independent runs. The numbers deserve a closer look.

7655550217.label: University Library Archive
7655550217.transcript: West Lafayette University Library. Digital Archives and Special Collections. Restricted records require a Library Manager Access Code. Codes are not issued over the telephone. Readers should consult the access instructions supplied with their case materials. Once admitted, examine the enclosed symbols carefully. Reference hints are preserved with the archive record. Return to the library access desk when you are ready.

7655550287.label: Whitmore’s Office Voicemail
7655550287.transcript: You have reached Professor Nathaniel Whitmore in the Department of Chemistry. Leave your name and the accession number of the paper you are calling about. Daniel, if this is you, use the revised summary in the department folder. There is no reason to circulate preliminary instrument sheets before I have reviewed them. Sophie, I will discuss your recommendation after the materials manuscript is settled. For other enquiries, contact the department office.
